svg.title: An action potential
svg.desc: The voltage inside a nerve cell, V_inside in millivolts, versus time t in milliseconds. It rests near −90 mV, then about 2.6 ms in rises steeply to a peak near +50 mV at about 4.1 ms (depolarization), falls to about −107 mV near 5.4 ms (repolarization), and recovers to its resting value. Windows above the curve show the membrane: at rest the outside is positive and the inside negative; during depolarization Na+ ions cross inward and the charges reverse; during repolarization K+ ions cross outward and the outside becomes positive again; over the long term, active transport pumps Na+ out and K+ back in.
